description: This Java source file defines a class `CapturingMdcAdapterObserver` which extends an abstract observer class for MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, used in logging. Its purpose is to capture and record MDC put and remove operations for testing assertions.

classes.name: CapturingMdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: A thread-safe class that captures MDC put entries and removed keys for testing purposes, extending `ObservableMdcAdapter.AbstractMdcAdapterObserver`.

methods.name: CapturingMdcAdapterObserver
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread-safe collections to record put entries and removed keys.

methods.name: onPut
methods.description: Records a key-value pair when an MDC put operation occurs.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Records a key when an MDC remove operation occurs.

methods.name: getAllPutEntries
methods.description: Returns a copy of all put entries recorded.

methods.name: getAllRemovedKeys
methods.description: Returns a copy of all removed keys recorded.
